sources.snippet: Model Details Model Card for OLMo 2 1B We introduce OLMo 2 1B, the smallest model in the OLMo 2 family. OLMo 2 was pre-trained on OLMo-mix-1124 and uses Dolmino-mix-1124 for mid-training. OLMo 2 is the latest in a series of O pen L anguage Mo dels designed to enable the science of language models.
